sourceText: Implement Progressive Intent Hardening M0-M2 only. Freeze terminology, add original_intent_snapshot_set/get, milestone_ledger_set/add/get, proofstory_contract_set/get, intent_coverage_check --dryRun, proofstory_gate_check --dryRun, and internal classification. Default observe/warn, do not enforce lifecycle gates, red evidence, spike promotion, DONE equivalence, or REVIEW completeness in this first batch. Provide a milestone completion table.
normalizedOutcome: ProofStory M0-M2 can freeze user intent, count triggered milestones, store a diagnostic contract, and report dry-run DEV-readiness gaps without lifecycle enforcement.
acceptanceClaim: The new commands work through Lattice CLI, dry-run diagnostics report missing artifacts and triggered hardening gaps, process facts mark these artifacts diagnostic-only, and tests prove ordinary low-risk features remain Intent MVP.
